svg.title: Philoctetes alone on Lemnos, seated on a rock under a tree, his bandaged leg drawn up, his bow case beside him
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Attic red-figure squat lekythos in the manner of the Eretria Painter, c. 420 BCE, New York, Metropolitan Museum of Art 56.171.58; traced from photographs by Marie-Lan Nguyen (CC BY 2.5) and the Metropolitan Museum of Art (CC0), changed.
